items.Name: +2 Defending Dagger
items.Description: This blade is often commonly seen among swashbucklers. As it offers extra protection without having to use a shield. Something most dislike using.

items.Name: Cloak of Balduran
items.Description: This cloak was reputedly worn by Balduran, the founder of Baldur's Gate. Though it was never used in combat, it provides protection worthy of any great leader.

items.Name: Guktok's Chopper
items.Description: This huge axe belonged to Guktok, an orc chieftain. Guktok was infamous among his kind for his victories against several dwarven outposts in the north. He was also known for his extreme cruelty that he expressed if any dwarf was unlucky enough to be his captive. He met a horribl…
PropertiesDecoded: Dwarf Enhancement Bonus vs. Racial Group +4

items.Name: Light Elven Chainmail
items.Description: Forged by the lengendary inhabitants of Myth Drannor. This even lighter version of the more reknown elven chainmail.  It was most often used by those who wanted to cast spells unencumbered.
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 60% of Weight

items.Name: Wyvernskin Leather
items.Description: This rare leather is made from wyvern hide hence it's rarity.  Wyvern hide is tough and extremly durable.  Unfortunely, many unlucky adventurers have found thier demise seeking a new suit of it.

items.Name: Staff of the Healing Arts
items.Description: This staff was made by the mage Earwin Dussell, the Athiest. He found clerics and thier religious dogma irritating to have in the party. So, he crafted this staff that he lovingly referred to as the " Cleric on a Stick".
PropertiesDecoded: Cure Moderate Wounds (6) Cast Spell 1 Charge/Use

items.Name: Full Circle
items.Description:
This weapon was created with one purpose in mind: making the undead, dead. The inscription reads:

 "LIFE DEATH FULL CIRCLE."
PropertiesDecoded: Undead AC Bonus vs. Racial Group +2
Undead Damage Bonus vs. Racial Type 1d6 Damage

items.Name: The Keen Fang
items.Description: "The Keen Fang" is etched in Infernal Runes upon the pommel of this blade. Although the weapon itself is not evil, it's creator most likely was.

items.Name: Mace of Undead Cleansing
items.Description:
This mace has inscribed upon the shaft:

"To death bring life."

This weapon was created to battle undead. It is a finely crafted weapon, nonetheless, but it is extremely effective against the undead.
PropertiesDecoded: Undead Damage Bonus vs. Racial Type 2d12 Damage

items.Name: Kalidor Heavy Cavalry Brigandine
items.Description: This suit of armor saw action in the Mage Wars in Kalidor. It still has tell-tale scortchmarks and electrical burns blemishing it's otherwise fine finish.

items.Name: Black Kukri
items.Description: This kukri has no markings on it, as it was made in absolute secrecy, to be sure. It is the blade of a stealthy, quick,  yet anonymous, assassin. A lucky find, indeed.

items.Name: Staff of Flame
items.Description: This staff was crafted by a wizard with an affinity for fire-based spells, and was very likely not combat-shy, as this staff was made for close battling as well as ranged. No inscriptions identify it's maker.
PropertiesDecoded: Wall of Fire (9) Cast Spell 2 Charges/Use

items.Name: Demonskull Helm
items.Description: This helmet, which is fashioned from the actual skull of a demon, imparts some of the resistances of that demon upon it's wearer. No markings identify the maker.

items.Name: Albruin +1
items.Description: Albruin Basalin was a large man, rumored, far from his hearing, to be a were-bear. He long wielded the sword Albruin in the protection of his village, slaying giant spiders that plagued the area. The sword protected him from their poison and also allowed him to see invisible Red…

items.Name: Trogdor's Mail
items.Description:
Trogdor was a man. Actually, some believe Trogdor to be a dragon-man or rather, just a dragon, but he was still Trogdor. Trogdor terrorized the lands, burninating its peasants, burninating all the people, burninating the countryside, though Trogdor only comes in the night.

Beli…
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 20% of Weight

items.Name: Glorious Revolution
items.Description: These crossbows were used by the leaders of the Glorious Revolution, a popular uprising against the tyrannical Duke Bogob in the year 1217 DR. The oppressed workers in the fields rose up when they heard the rallying cry: "You have nothing to lose but your chains!" Unfortunately,…
PropertiesDecoded: Evil Attack Bonus vs. Alignment Group +5

items.Name: Bloodstone Double Axe
items.Description: Equipped at great expense, the Bloodstone mercenaries were a company desperate to prove their worth, but fate placed them outside what should have been the defining moment of their careers. In 1090 DR they were supposed to play a part in the Battle of the Bones, but their enhanc…

items.Name: Lesser Galena Sword
items.Description: Upon the discovery of the Great Galena Sword, many young fighters trekked up the mountainsides leaving their swords upon them for months, returning to see if their sword had somehow become enchanted like the Great Galena Sword. This is one of the few that did.

items.Name: Robe of Vecna
items.Description: This robe doesn't even have close to the power that the two famous artifacts, the Hand and Eye of Vecna possess.  Still, from simply being worn by the powerful lich, the robe absorbed enough magical energies to become a potent magic item.

items.Name: Staff of Rynn +4
items.Description: There was a time when magic was distrusted even more so than now, and the burning of "heretics" was woefully common. Delmarey, a witch from the swamplands near Myth Rynn, faced just such a fate when she was blamed for an unseasonable drought. Taken by surprise and sentenced by a…

items.Name: Bleederkin
items.Description: In recent years, a number of thieves' guilds reported losing members to these blades, the weapons left as gruesome signatures impaled in the victims' chests. The craftsman behind them was unknown, but the intent of the group using them was clear enough: to destabilize existing g…

items.Name: Frostreaver Battle Axe +3
items.Description: This was the axe of Illgarth, a Frost Giant that terrorized northern communities long ago.  It is not known where he acquired the weapon, but he took a perverse pleasure in unleashing it upon small folk, particularly halflings.  Ice and acid maimed those not killed, and the gian…

items.Name: Staff of Deathshine
items.Description: This staff was created by the Necromantic Wizard, Benneric. He referred to negative energy as "deathshine" in an effort to coin a new term. He failed miserably, and died during one of his ill-concieved experiments with "deathshine". Nobody really missed him.
PropertiesDecoded: Negative Energy Burst (5) Cast Spell 2 Charges/Use
Negative Energy Ray (3) Cast Spell 1 Charge/Use

items.Name: Unholy Greatsword (13)
items.Description: This is a sword that is typical of a Doom Knight. This particular sword was cleaved from the hands of Gribb, the Frost Giant Jarl. It was a simple dagger to him, and it is said that he used it to pick meat from his jagged, rotting teeth.
PropertiesDecoded: Chaotic Evil Use Limitation: Specific Alignment

items.Name: Greataxe +2: Life Giver
items.Description: This mighty weapon consists of a four- to five-foot haft with a very heavy blade. items.Name: Entropy
items.Description: Entropy This +2 abyssal greensteel blade is one of Haer'Dalis' favorite weapons. There are many others like it, but this one is yours.

items.Name: Silvermane's Axe
items.Description: Silvermane, heroine of the dwarves, had a jealous stepsister, Selarna, who she killed in battle. Selarna's spirit became trapped within the killing axe. From her vantage point within that blade, Selarna took her vengeance by provoking many subsequent wielders to kill their sibli…
PropertiesDecoded: Raise Dead (9) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: The Dagger of Chaos
items.Description: This dagger was a gift from Targus, God of War, to Serreg of Neverwinter. It currently takes the shap…

items.Description: This rare leather is made from wyvern hide hence it's rarity.  Wyvern hide is tough and extremly durable.  Unfortunely, many unlucky adventurers have found thier demise seeking a new suit of it.

items.Name: Ring of Immortality
items.Description: As long as this ring is worn, it's wearer is said to be immortal, and the inscription on the band agrees with this claim. It is, however, simply a powerful regeneration ring.

items.Name: Holy Symbol of Helm Ring
items.Description:
Only those most worthy and devoted servants of the Watcher are granted these powerful holy symbols.

Helm, the god of guardians and protectors, is the epitome of the guardian, the watcher, and has in years past been greatly venerated by those who need to remain watchful for evil…

Cleric Bonus Spell Slot of Level Level 8

items.Name: Gift of Peace
items.Description: Prized for its noble origin as much as for its benefits to the wearer, this helm was originally intended to be a simple gift. items.Name: Visage of Slaying
items.Description: The mad necromancer-lich N'Ashtar Nikadeemus forged this helmet from the bones of  his own parents.  His highest ranked general would wear it when he rode into battle, using it to instantly slay the commanders of the opposing army.  After that the skeletal armies of N'Ashtar wou…
PropertiesDecoded: Power Word, Kill (17) Cast Spell 1 Use/Day

items.Name: Skin of the Ghoul +3
items.Description: A clever thief, Damien Oneknife always tried to gain from the assets of his enemies, no matter the circumstances. items.Name: Saw-Toothed Glaive
items.Description: The blade of this polearm resonates violently when it strines an opponent, causing greivous wounds. It's maker is unknown.

items.Name: Sequencer Robes of Terent
items.Description: The fabric of this robe is woven from thin strips of a mysterious material that is capable of storing magical spells. A caster need only cast a defensive spell upon the robe. The robe will then store the spell so that it may be cast at a later time, instantly. This robe is capab…

items.Name: Serpent Ring
items.Description: This appears to be a baby serpent of some sort that has been frozen into the shape of a ring. Its eyes glitter and swirl like jewels and even appear to move occasionally.

items.Name: Foebane +3
items.Description: The Archmage Demron created this powerful blade for Captain Fflar of Myth Drannor.  When the elven city fell, the sword was lost beneath the rubble of the once great metropolis.

items.Name: Wyvern's Tail +2
items.Description: The large spike at the head of this morningstar is actually the lethal stinger of a wyvern. items.Name: Greataxe of Vurk
items.Description: This is the greataxe of Vurk the Conquerer. He has slain many, yet never cleaned the blade. The foulness of this blade causes more problems than simply gaping wounds.

When the pit fiend Azavistos was slain and reduced to lermure status by a pair of devas on the Prime Material Plane, his evil mace Malefactor -- crafted from green Baatorian steel -- was brought to the aasimon citadel of Xal Brivala on Ysgard, and there it remained for one hundr…
PropertiesDecoded: Chaotic Evil Damage Bonus vs. Specific Alignment 1d8 Damage

items.Name: Bone Armor
items.Description: This armor is painstakingly crafted from small bits of bone infused with various metals. The resultant mixture of bone and metal creates a lightweight, strong, suit of mail. However, it gives of a powerful magical and evil aura.
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 60% of Weight

items.Name: Dominator Staff
items.Description: This staff was made by Verniton Del'Ki'sherr, the elven Mage/Fighter. He was a powerful mage and a skilled fighter, but a master of neither. He was, however a master artisan, and this staff is testament to that. He retired from adventuring, in obscurity ( at the ripe, young age …

Ray of Enfeeblement (2) Cast Spell 1 Charge/Use
Electric Jolt On Hit Cast Spell Level 1

items.Name: Nightbringer
items.Description: This morningstar is etched with the name "Nightbringer". It's maker's marks are obscured and gouged by years of use and wear, but it appears to be of Dwarven craftsmanship. It emits a low pitched whine when swung.
PropertiesDecoded: Sleep On Hit Cast Spell Level 5

items.Name: Demonslayer +4
items.Description: The weapon's name is misleading, as this weapon will slay angels and archons, just as well as demons and devils with ease. The weapon, however will not function in the hands of a wielder if there is even the slightest hint of evil or selfishness in thier heart.

items.Description: Seamignon the wizard was plagued with a few minor disadvantages. Being a scrawny pale-skinned human of slight stature, with poor vision wasn't bad enough. He was afraid of the dark, and could not stand the cold. He felt faint at the sight of blood. He was hardly strong enough t…

items.Name: Harpoon of Doom
items.Description: The tip of this spear crackles with electrical fury. It bears no marks to identify it's maker, and bears no clues to suggest it's history. The metal is unlike anything of this world, and a small switch activates and deactivates it. It hums with anticipation.

items.Name: The Unholy Harvester
items.Description: Wielding this weapon is extremely uncomfortable. It causes it's weilder to break out in hives, itch, and causes relentless fever chills. All this pales in comparison to what it's target must feel.
PropertiesDecoded: Chaotic Evil Use Limitation: Specific Alignment

items.Description: Soul Piercer is a rapier fashioned from the horn of a unicorn that was driven mad with bloodlust. The unicorn was captured by demons and tortured for hundreds of years by generations of demons. Just when the unicorn thought it's pain was going to end, while on the verge of deat…

items.Name: Magnus' Fighter Belt
items.Description: Magnus the Magekiller, whose brother Jemmin was, ironically enough, a wizard, made this belt for him. Although he hated spellcasters with a passion, he was overprotective of his own brother. Magnus died while interfering with a mage-duel between Jemmin and Archmage Verlix. Magn…

items.Name: Fire Spewing Composite Longbow
items.Description: This powerful bow's history is unknown and it bears no maker's marks. It is likely one of a kind, but any knowledge of it's existence is shrouded in obscurity. It is almost certainly priceless.

items.Name: Battlemage Armor
items.Description: This armor is lightly constructed of strong materials, so as to not interfere with spell-casting, while providing the protection of heavy armor. It bear's no maker's marks, but it does bear a serial number of N00001, and is likely not just the first, but the only of it's kind.

items.Name: Greater Gloves of Healing
items.Description: These are a pair of gloves that were, as it is widely believed, worn by Pelor himself.

items.Name: Brightblade Dagger
items.Description: This dagger gives off bright light at all times unless sheathed. Other than that, it is a normal dagger in most respects.

items.Name: Elven Sewn Gloves
items.Description: These gloves have been made from the highest quality cloth and furs available in the land. items.Name: Orc Warbow
items.Description: This ugly but powerful weapon has been designed to take advantage of a stronger pull than most normal bows.

items.Name: Quiet Boots
items.Description: These well-worn leather boots were frequently used by the thug and part-time killer Renny the Fist. items.Description: This cloak is an evil thing, albeit powerful. Made from the poorly stitched together skin of innocent nymphs, this cloak grants the wearer immunity to fear and panic.

items.Name: Cloak of Meat Smell
items.Description: This ordinary-looking cloak provides its user with protection against cold, and can also call upon a blessing once per day.  It bears a strong smell of meat, however, one that cannot be removed no matter how many times the cloak is washed.

items.Name: Black Leather Armor +1
items.Description: This leather armor is dyed black to hide it's wearer in the shadows more effectively. It is also enhanced with a +1 bonus.

items.Name: Ringmail of the Bard +1
items.Description:
This light armor is made similar to chainmail, except the links are much larger, and sewn to a leather backing.

items.Name: Tusked Helm
items.Description: This helm is of good quality in design and craftsmanship. Spines and tusks are added for intimidation purposes, but otherwise do not provide many tangible benefits.

items.Name: Quilted Armor of Bonn
items.Description: Armor made of padded cloth. Similar in most respects to padded armor. This particular suit was crafted by Bonn the tailor, and is of masterwork quality.

items.Name: Amulet of Keen Eyes
items.Description:
This amulet grants it's wearer keener vision. It has an inscription which reads:
"If you find this amulet, do not rely as heavily upon it as I did. It has not served me as well as I had intended, as you now possess it. THURM."

items.Name: Luck Amulet
items.Description:
This silver amulet bears an inscription on the rear face: 

"To my darling husband Kalos, may this trinket protect you and return you safe to me." 

It appears to have been enchanted with protective, good-aligned magicks.
PropertiesDecoded: Evil AC Bonus vs. Alignment Group +1

items.Name: Black Full Plate +1
items.Description: This suit of platemail is normal +1 platemail, but the metal has been plated with a permanent black pigmentation.

items.Name: Tome of Missiles
items.Description: This "tome" is actually a binding for 20 scrolls of Magic Missile.

items.Name: Storm Spirit Sword
items.Description: This magically enhanced masterwork blade seems to pulse with a chaotic, roiling energy that feels almost eager to lash out at the living.

items.Name: Elfbane Arrows
items.Description: These deadly missiles, crafted by orc shamans, exist for one purpose alone: to slay elves.  Against other creatures they are only slightly more effective than normal arrows.

items.Name: Orog Full Plate
items.Description: Forged by orog smiths deep within the fastness of their mountain holds, this armor is as black as the hearts of the warriors that wear it.

items.Name: Screaming Acid Bullet
items.Description: This glass bullet appears to be filled with a weak acid, and is designed in such a way to explode on impact.

items.Name: Umber Hulk Plate
items.Description: The hard plates that protect umber hulks are reasonably easy to craft into humanoid armor. This dark suit of armor was fashioned into plate mail by duergar smiths. The dark dwarves, skilled in handling umber hulk exoskeletons, cured and reinforced the armor.

items.Description: This shield seems to draw projectiles toward the circle at it's center in an effort to better protect the weilder. Athough finely crafted it bears no maker's marks.

items.Name: Breastplate +2
items.Description:
This armor appears to be fashioned by Pard Mard, great uncle of Gard Mard, the cowardly assassin and miscreant of
legend, that plagued such places as Danterholm, Bilgemoor, Kalidor, Stillwater, and Avorel, among others.

items.Name: Bolts Of Festering
items.Description: These bolts can inflict a disease upon whatever or whomever they strike.

items.Name: Cloak of the Winter Wolf

items.Description: A sickle that was obviously made solely because of the bad pun.

items.Description:
This axe imparts defensive magicks to it's wielder. It is of masterwork craftsmanship and well-balanced, as well. It is inscribed with dwarven runes. Translation:
 " IT TAKES THOUSANDS A HUNDRED GENERATIONS TO MOVE A MOUNTAIN. BE A MOUNTAIN."

items.Name: Heartseeker
items.Description: This weapon seems to guide the weilder's strike towards his enemy's more vital areas.

items.Name: Battlerobe of Might
items.Description: This robe magically shrugs off damage as if it were a suit of mail, indeed, sometimes better.

items.Name: Staff of the Holy
items.Description: The faithful teach that a Staff of the Holy is the will of a deity made manifest. While this is debatable, these items do tend to find their way to the hands of the truly righteous, by accident or design. Still, the number of these staffs in circulation makes the miraculous orig…

items.Name: Bracers of Endurance
items.Description: These wristbands look like normal protective wear. This bracer makes it's wearer stronger and healthier.

items.Name: Battle Wand
items.Description: These wands are issued to the defenders of Lord Piergeiron's castle in case of attack.  Though produced in great quantities in time of war, very few go unused during peacetime.

items.Name: Book of Healing
items.Description: This is not actually a book per se, it is more of a collection of healing scrolls. Either way it can be a life-saving item to possess.

items.Description: These are the boots of the long dead warrior monk Luce Bree. He was very well known for fighting and prevailing against multiple opponents.

items.Name: Gloves of Healing
items.Description: These gloves are usually given to novices of the Most Noble Order of the Radiant Heart who have yet to acquire the ability to cast spells.  For anyone outside of the Order to wear these gloves is a rare honor.

items.Description: This barbarian-only armor was created in the northern frozen wastelands to cope with the frigid conditions. But, that doesn't mean it's not fit for battle.

items.Name: Defender Hammer
items.Description: An enchanted and dwarven-crafted hammer of excellent quality. It bears no mark of a specific maker. It will only function properly in the hands of a Dwarven Defender.

items.Name: Uhir's Knife
items.Description: This unremarkable, dirt-caked dagger has the letters 'UHIR' carved into its handle. Despite its shoddy appearance, the blade is well-balanced.

items.Name: Little Avenger
items.Description: This sword was the Holy Avenger of Basinicus the Pure. He was slain battling demons in the 665th plane of the Abyss, and his Avenger was broken into bits. items.Name: Frostborn Greataxe
items.Description: A well-forged and crafted axe from the Northlands. It was forged and cooled in extreme cold, and still emanates some of the frosty death.

items.Name: Sylvan Darts
items.Description: These magical arrows feel warm to the touch, and feel almost as if they were still part of a living tree.  The heads look like wood, part of the shaft, but they are sharper than forged steel.

items.Name: Arrows of the Cataclysm
items.Description:
Arrows forged by the Arcane Archer known as "Snipes". Each arrow is enscribed in the Elven tongue:

"TO WHOM IT MAY CONCERN"

items.Name: Belt of the Bull
items.Description:
This plain belt makes the wearer as strong as an ox, but does not make him or her any larger - nor does it change appearance.

Many a cocky warrior has been surprised by a much smaller opponent with remarkable strength.  More often than not a belt such as this is the reason.

items.Name: Bladesinger Chain +4
items.Description: The lore of this suit is difficult to determine, either due to the exotic circumstances from which it sprang, or the wish of its previous owner to conceal its location. items.Description: This is the armor of the House Staggard Light Infantry. You are lucky to have found this.

items.Description: This armor is made from the hide of a troll. The disgusting ichor that heals a troll is still secreted by the magically treated hide, thereby healing the wearer. It smells horrible, though.
